questions.stem: These three bedside images compare a normal aerated lung with two patterns of increased lung water at the pleural surface. What imaging modality is being used?

explanation.summary: Horizontal A-lines and vertical B-lines are reverberation artifacts seen on lung ultrasound; a heterogeneous, patchy B-line distribution favors ARDS over the homogeneous pattern of cardiogenic pulmonary edema.
explanation.whyCorrect: Horizontal A-lines and vertical B-lines are reverberation artifacts seen on lung ultrasound; a heterogeneous, patchy B-line distribution favors ARDS over the homogeneous pattern of cardiogenic pulmonary edema.

questions.stem: This lung section from a patient with acute respiratory failure shows widened alveolar septa, intra-alveolar hemorrhage, and inflammatory cells filling airspaces. What underlying process does this represent?

explanation.summary: ARDS is the clinical correlate of diffuse alveolar damage, characterized by alveolar epithelial and endothelial injury, protein-rich exudate, and inflammatory infiltration of airspaces.
explanation.whyCorrect: ARDS is the clinical correlate of diffuse alveolar damage, characterized by alveolar epithelial and endothelial injury, protein-rich exudate, and inflammatory infiltration of airspaces.

questions.stem: This lung histology from a patient with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure shows airspaces lined by glassy, eosinophilic material together with inflammatory cells. This lining material indicates which phase of which disease?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Exudative phase of diffuse alveolar damage (ARDS)

choices.label: B
choices.text: Resolution phase of cardiogenic pulmonary edema

choices.label: C
choices.text: Organizing phase of usual interstitial pneumonia

explanation.summary: Eosinophilic hyaline membranes lining alveolar ducts are the histologic hallmark of the early exudative phase of diffuse alveolar damage seen in ARDS.
explanation.whyCorrect: Eosinophilic hyaline membranes lining alveolar ducts are the histologic hallmark of the early exudative phase of diffuse alveolar damage seen in ARDS.
